content.text:
upload_dir: /data/upload
ui_dir: /app/ui

# logging.config.dictConfig
logging:
  version: 1
  disable_existing_loggers: false
  log_dir: /data/logs
  formatters:
    simple:
      format: '%(asctime)s:%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(funcName)s:%(lineno)d:%(message)s'
  handlers:
    stdout:
      class: logging.StreamHandler
      formatter: simple
      stream: ext://sys.stdout
  root:
    handlers:
    - stdout
    level: DEBUG
  loggers:
    websockets.client:
      handlers:
        - stdout
      level: INFO
      propagate: false


server:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8090

database:
  conn_str: 'sqlite:////data/asr-service.db'

message_queue:
  name: asr-cpu
  host: redis
  port: 6379


jobs:
  worker: 2

language_detector:
#  savedir: /data/.cache/speechbrain
  fallback: de
  probability: 0.65
  supported:
    - de
    - fr
    - en

extensions:
  - name: asr_service_openai_api
    # TODO path should be necessary
    path: ../asr_service_openai_api
  - name: asr_service_voxtral
    path: ../asr_service_voxtral
  - name: asr_service_qwen
    path: ../asr_service_qwen
  - name: asr_service_whisper
    path: ../asr_service_whisper

presets:
  - id: default
    base: whisperx
    options:
      - process_type: transcribe
        asr:
          beam_size: 5
          compression_ratio_threshold: 2.4
          condition_on_previous_text: false
          initial_prompt: null
          length_penalty: 1.0
          log_prob_threshold: -1.0
          no_speech_threshold: 0.6
          patience: 1.0
          suppress_numerals: null
          suppress_tokens:
            - -1
          temperature: 0
          temperature_increment_on_fallback: 0.2
        hf_token: null
        language: null
        model: large-v3
        model_dir: null
        model_variant: whisperx
        print_progress: true
        threads: 4
        vad:
          chunk_size: 30
          vad_offset: 0.363
          vad_onset: 0.5
        verbose: true
        batch_size: 4
        compute_type: int8
        device: cpu
        device_index: 0
      - process_type: align
        align_model: null
        interpolate_method: nearest
        no_align: false
        return_char_alignments: null
      - process_type: diarize
        base: pyannote
        diarize: true
#        model_path: /models/diarization.generated.yaml
        max_speakers: null
        min_speakers: null
  - id: realtime
    base: openai_api
    options:
      - process_type: realtime
        url: http://localhost:8000/v1/realtime
        api_key: null
        model: mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602
